# "Also builds" collapse Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** In a feature card's "Built by" rows, a component that also builds many other features shows one chip and a `…N more` button; clicking it shows the rest and turns into `show less`, which folds them again.

**Architecture:** The score review page (`assets/score-review.html`) is generated by `scripts/build-template.mjs` from the mockup in `docs/mockups/estimate-workflow-mode/`, and the Component-based page (`assets/estimate-components.html`) is generated by `scripts/build-components-template.mjs` from `assets/score-review.html`. So one change in `build-template.mjs` reaches both pages. The chip markup moves into a new `scripts/template/also-builds.js` (spliced in by a `rep()`), its CSS into `scripts/template/also-builds.css`. Every chip is still rendered; the folded ones carry class `more` and are hidden by CSS until the row's `.calso` gets class `open`.

**Tech Stack:** Plain browser JS inside HTML templates, Node `node:test`, headless Chrome via `analyze-requirements/scripts/lib/cdp.mjs`.

**Spec:** none; the user's request (2026-10-20): "I want it collapsed as default, sample: `also build [feat-001]...7 more`, so when I click on 7 more it will expand the rest, I also can collapse it again." Applies to the score review and the estimate (Component-based) page.

## Global Constraints

- Never edit `assets/score-review.html` or `assets/estimate-components.html` by hand. Change the builders/template files, then regenerate both assets; `build-template.test.mjs` and `build-pages.test.mjs` pin the assets byte for byte.
- Show 1 chip when folded. Fold only when there are 3 or more other features (2 chips are shown as they are, no button).
- Button text: `…N more` (N = hidden chips, `…` is U+2026) when folded, `show less` when open.
- Template script gate (`quality-gates.test.mjs`, `TEMPLATE_LIMITS`): ≤22 lines per function, ≤3 params. Repo gates for `.mjs`: ≤20 lines/function, ≤3 params, nesting ≤2, ≤200 lines and ≤10 functions per file.
- No apostrophes inside template literals in template JS (the gate reads them as string quotes).
- Commits: Conventional Commits, subject ≤50 chars, no AI attribution trailers.
- Version: solution-architect 3.2.0 → 3.2.1 in `plugins/solution-architect/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Do not push (a plugin.json change on main publishes).

## Review Focus

1. Clicking `…N more` must not pin or highlight anything (the page pins on clicks on `[data-cap-chip]` / `[data-comp-chip]`). `hitAt()` already ignores `button:not(.dot)`; the test asserts `#pinbar` stays hidden.
2. Rows with 1 or 2 other features: no button, all chips visible. Test with the stock fixture (office on FEAT-001 has 2 others).
3. The Component-based page (FINAL, read-only) gets the same behaviour, since it is built from the review template. Its own browser test.
4. No console errors on either page after toggling twice (`page.errors` stays `[]`).
5. Accepted, not tested: an edit that repaints the card (unlink, link, ask) re-renders the rows folded. Open state is not kept across repaints.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

Create `scripts/test/also-builds-browser.test.mjs`:

```js
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { staged } from './stage.mjs';
import { findChrome } from '../../../../analyze-requirements/scripts/lib/chrome.mjs';
import { openPage } from '../../../../analyze-requirements/scripts/lib/cdp.mjs';

const skip = !findChrome();
const fx = (n) => fileURLToPath(new URL(`./fixtures/${n}`, import.meta.url));
const at = (n) => fileURLToPath(new URL(`../${n}`, import.meta.url));
const settle = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
// office builds FEAT-001, 003, 005; adding 002 and 004 gives FEAT-001's row 4 others
const wide = (i) => i.components.find((c) => c.id === 'office').builds.push({ feature: 'FEAT-002', why: 'a' }, { feature: 'FEAT-004', why: 'b' });

function review(mutate) {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'wf-also-'));
  const inputs = JSON.parse(readFileSync(fx('inputs-pass.json'), 'utf8'));
  if (mutate) mutate(inputs);
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'estimation-inputs.json'), JSON.stringify(inputs));
  copyFileSync(fx('requirements.json'), join(dir, 'requirements.json'));
  execFileSync('node', [at('score-review.mjs'), '--write', join(dir, 'estimation-inputs.json'), '--out', join(dir, 'review.html')]);
  return pathToFileURL(join(dir, 'review.html')).href;
}
function components(mutate) {
  const dir = staged(mutate);
  execFileSync('node', [at('render.mjs'), '--inputs', join(dir, 'estimation-inputs.json'), '--json', join(dir, 'estimation.json'), '--out', join(dir, 'dist')]);
  return pathToFileURL(join(dir, 'dist', 'estimate-components.html')).href;
}

const ROW = `document.querySelector('[data-builtby="FEAT-001"] [data-comp-chip="office"] .calso')`;
const shown = (page) => page.eval(`[...${ROW}.querySelectorAll('.cmini')].filter((x) => getComputedStyle(x).display !== 'none').map((x) => x.dataset.capChip)`);
const button = (page) => page.eval(`(() => { const b = ${ROW}.querySelector('[data-also-more]'); return b && { text: b.textContent, open: b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') }; })()`);
const toggle = (page) => page.eval(`${ROW}.querySelector('[data-also-more]').click()`);
const pinned = (page) => page.eval(`!document.getElementById('pinbar').classList.contains('hide')`);

async function foldsAndUnfolds(url) {
  const page = await openPage(url);
  try {
    await settle();
    assert.deepEqual(await shown(page), ['FEAT-003']);
    assert.deepEqual(await button(page), { text: '…3 more', open: 'false' });
    await toggle(page);
    assert.deepEqual(await shown(page), ['FEAT-003', 'FEAT-005', 'FEAT-002', 'FEAT-004']);
    assert.deepEqual(await button(page), { text: 'show less', open: 'true' });
    assert.equal(await pinned(page), false);
    await toggle(page);
    assert.deepEqual(await shown(page), ['FEAT-003']);
    assert.deepEqual(await button(page), { text: '…3 more', open: 'false' });
    assert.deepEqual(page.errors, []);
  } finally { await page.close(); }
}

test('score review: 3+ other features fold behind "…N more" and unfold', { skip }, () => foldsAndUnfolds(review(wide)));

test('estimate (component-based): the same fold', { skip }, () => foldsAndUnfolds(components(wide)));

test('two other features show both chips and no button', { skip }, async () => {
  const page = await openPage(review());
  try {
    await settle();
    assert.deepEqual(await shown(page), ['FEAT-003', 'FEAT-005']);
    assert.equal(await button(page), null);
    assert.deepEqual(page.errors, []);
  } finally { await page.close(); }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the chip helper and its CSS**

Create `scripts/template/also-builds.js` (no trailing content after the last line's newline):

```js
// the other features a component builds: 3 or more fold to one chip and "…N more"
const ALSO_SHOWN = 1; const ALSO_FOLD = 3;
const alsoChip = (c, fold) => `<span class="cmini${fold ? ' more' : ''}" style="--sc:var(--s${sysNo(c)})" data-cap-chip="${c}" title="${esc(capById[c].name)}">${c}</span>`;
function alsoHtml(others) {
  if (!others.length) return '<span class="dim">only this feature</span>';
  const fold = others.length >= ALSO_FOLD;
  const chips = others.map((c, i) => alsoChip(c, fold && i >= ALSO_SHOWN)).join('');
  const more = fold ? `<button type="button" class="alsomore" data-also-more aria-expanded="false">…${others.length - ALSO_SHOWN} more</button>` : '';
  return `also builds ${chips}${more}`;
}
function toggleAlso(b) {
  const box = b.closest('.calso'); const open = box.classList.toggle('open');
  b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
  b.textContent = open ? 'show less' : `…${box.querySelectorAll('.cmini.more').length} more`;
}
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { const b = e.target.closest('[data-also-more]'); if (b) toggleAlso(b); });
```

Create `scripts/template/also-builds.css`:

```css
.crow .calso:not(.open) .cmini.more { display:none; }
.alsomore { font:inherit; font-size:.74rem; color:var(--ink-dim); background:none; border:0; padding:0 .2rem; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:underline dotted; }
.alsomore:hover, .alsomore:focus-visible { color:var(--ink); }
```
